correctness.rationale: The regeneration identity pi_r=r delta_0 sum_k s^k P^k gives a normalized invariant distribution and uniqueness by TV contraction with factor s per step. Reversibility yields G_s(0,n)=m_n G_s(n,0); the strong Markov property along successive lower-site first hits factors the latter as G_s(0,0) times the product of the w_j. The reversible weight product has m_n proportional asymptotically to n^(−2 epsilon) and p_n tends to 1/2; divergent edge resistances on the positive half-line (2 epsilon > −1 in the stated range) give almost-sure lower hits. Each w_j rises strictly and continuously from zero to one, and the first two target constants lie strictly between those endpoints. At r_1, the exact site-one balance pi(1)=s[pi(0)/2+(2+epsilon)pi(2)/4] yields pi(2)/pi(1)=2(2−s)/(s(2+epsilon))>1. Thus r_2>r_1, and continuity preserves pi(2)>pi(0) immediately to the right of r_1. Positive summable masses and strict separation from site one guarantee an attained outer maximum on each side. Each adjacent ratio is strictly decreasing in r, so equalities are countable; in the claimed window there are in fact only finitely many potentially tied pairs since w_n≤s≤1−r_1 and m_n/m_(n−1) tends to one. A plateau of four positive sites would force 1=s[1−epsilon/(j²−1)] at two distinct interior sites j≥2, impossible; this also justifies the qualitative 'short plateau' wording. An independent recurrence evaluated with outward rounding and tail bounds 0≤w_501≤1 encloses r_1 near 0.00740343587959632569 and r_2 near 0.03099729756312700554 within widths below 8e−31, confirming the quoted decimals. value.rationale: Local attraction caused by resetting and outward displacement of the stationary mass are not mutually exclusive. This example gives a strict central peak and two side peaks for an open interval across the entire stated outward-bias regime, not just a tuned numerical profile. The exact neighboring-site comparisons isolate the mechanism and give a region where the reset-site peak is lower than outer mass, while leaving the full inventory of extrema explicitly open.
